text: marie: Quick UX check — the docs card in Console's Models list uses "model version" on the card title but our docs and API surface use "serving version". Customers might be confused. Also the "View docs" CTA opens a new tab but theres no indication for screen readers. dan: Agree. We should standardize to "serving version" everywhere. @priya can we update the inline docs? Also we should add an aria-label to the CTA like `aria-label="Open docs (opens in new tab)"`. priya: Yep. I can change doc headings. Quick question — for the in-product docs panel do we want it to open the external docs in a new tab or surface an inline side panel? Current flow opens external. ash: From infra POV external is simplest, but an inline preview would cut down context switching. If we do inline, keep it lightweight (just the first section + anchor to full docs). Also note our backend fields are `model_id` and `version_tag` — frontend should show `model name` + `serving version` to be user-friendly. sam: A11y notes: for links that open new tabs we should include `rel="noopener"` and either an `aria-label` that mentions the new tab or visually-hidden text that says "(opens in new tab)". Also we should test keyboard focus order on the card — pressing Enter should not accidentally trigger the primary link when a menu is focused. marie: Thanks. Priya, can you propose exact copy variants? Two short options for the CTA and the card subtitle. Dan, can you mock the aria update and the visually-hidden pattern? priya: Proposed copies: 1) Card subtitle: "Serving version: v2.1" 2) CTA visible text: "Open docs"; aria text: "Open docs (opens in new tab)" — short and explicit. I'll open a PR in the docs repo: `git checkout -b docs-ux/docs-card-copy` and push changes. dan: Mock snippet for CTA (HTML): ```html Open docs (opens in new tab) ``` ash: SGTM. If we add inline preview, let's gate it behind a flag `product.ui.docs_inline_preview` so we can roll it out slowly. I'll add the feature flag and a small cache for the preview HTML. marie: :thumbsup: OK let's keep this small. Action items: - priya: update docs headings + PR - dan: small UI change with aria-label + visually-hidden token - ash: add feature flag for inline preview - sam: quick keyboard/focus pass I'll follow up if we need an RFC or design pass. docs-bot: PR created: #1234 by priya — docs headings and CTA copy. Link: https://github.com/redwood/docs/pull/1234 priya: PR ready for review, assigning @dan and @sam.
